items.title: Skift Creator Summit: Five Decisions in the Room
items.summary: Creators now run production studios that drive brand storytelling, customer acquisition, booking behavior, and loyalty. The travel industry knows creators matter. The question is: how should brands build a system around them?

items.title: Skift Live Tourism Summit: Five Decisions in the Room
items.summary: Every destination has live events on its calendar. The open question is whether it builds anything lasting.

items.title: The Broken Creator-to-Booking Chain, and Why It Matters Now
items.summary: The fight in travel's creator economy has shifted. It used to be about attention, now it's about who gets the attribution for the booking.

items.title: Why Human Connection Is Hospitality’s Next Wellness Frontier
items.summary: As loneliness rises and travelers seek more meaningful time together, hospitality may have a new role to play in wellness. Evermore Orlando Resort is testing whether social connection can be intentionally designed into the guest experience and measured as an outcome of the stay.

items.title: Field & Stream Lodge Adds Two Hotels. Building the Brand Will Take Time.
items.summary: Field & Stream Lodge launched in 2023. Deals two and three are conversions in Bend and Big Bear, opening in 2028. Starwood Capital and AJ Capital say high capital costs are setting the pace for brand-building.

items.title: Lindblad Adds a Luxury Antarctic Brand in Its Latest Founder-Led Deal: Exclusive
items.summary: White Desert and Echo Charlie will keep their founder-led vision and culture while benefitting from Lindblad's resources and reach.

items.title: GetYourGuide Taps Creators to Write Reviews for Tour Operators
items.summary: Listings with no reviews can struggle to attract new customers. GetYourGuide is hoping an extensive network of content creators can help.

items.title: UAE Hotels Give Up on Q4, Hope for 2027 Recovery
items.summary: Hoteliers are getting occupancy back faster than rate — and it’s that gap, not just the war itself, pushing full recovery to 2027.
